notes.title: March 26th Official Release Day
notes.notes:
Drumpfy Walls releases on March 26th!

Game modes at launch: 

[b]Versus[/b]
"Reds" Vs "Blues", play against a friend in a volleyball style, 3 wins to win the match.

[b]Drumpfy Runner[/b]
Patrol the border as Drumpf, don't run out of calories tho! That border is long.

Characters at launch:

[b]"Reds"[/b]
Drumpf - God King of Mer'ca
Rainbow Mike - Princess of Mer'ca
Smilin' Barry - Former King of Mer'ca

[b]"Blues"[/b]
Jesus - Son of Actual God
BAC - Radical GoGo dancer and shot girl, err politician
Pander Bot - A robot designed to solicit votes

[b]More to come...[b]
